pool.text: Matthew Flinders charted parts of Moreton Bay.
John Oxley located the Brisbane River with the help of castaways.
The Moreton Bay penal settlement was established at Redcliffe.
The penal settlement moved from Redcliffe to North Quay.
German Lutherans established the first free settlement at Nundah.
The settlement closed and opened the district to free colonisation.
Brisbane was chosen as Queensland's capital upon separation.
Two destructive fires destroyed much of the early commercial centre.
The historic synagogue was established and designed by Arthur Morry.
The Great Flood inundated large areas and swept away Victoria Bridge.
The Story Bridge opened as a major infrastructure project.
Social pressures culminated in incidents known as the Battle of Brisbane.
Severe floods caused extensive damage and prompted water management changes.
Brisbane hosted major events including the Commonwealth Games.
South Bank Parklands opened on the redeveloped South Brisbane riverfront.
The Gallery of Modern Art opened within the cultural centre.
International students enrolled in universities and tertiary institutions in large numbers.
The Brisbane wattle was added as an additional floral emblem.
Queensland introduced a 50-cent flat fare initiative in August.
Metro services began operating alongside wider bus network changes.
